name: tikz-vscode-ext
description: Fine-grained syntax highlighting for the TikZ graphical language inside LaTeX documents.

tikz.figureScript.description: Script run to preview a single figure. It is given the path of the active file, and run from the first folder that contains it (the workspace root, or a subfolder named in tikz.scriptFolders).

tikz.buildScript.description: Script run to build the whole document, when the active file is not a figure.

tikz.figureFolders.description: Regular expression matching the name of a folder that holds figures. A file in one of these is previewed with tikz.figureScript rather than triggering a full build.

tikz.scriptFolders.description: Folders under the workspace root to search for the scripts, in order. Lets the sources sit in a subdirectory.

semanticTokenTypes.description: A control sequence defined in this file with \def, \newcommand or \pgfmathsetmacro.
A pgfkeys style defined by name/.style anywhere in the workspace.
